summary: Replaced biased 'prefer yes' prompt with neutral instruction to treat tool negatives as non-definitive and prioritize direct visual re-examination.

edits.hypothesis: Replacing the corrupted, task-specific prompt with a clean, general instruction to treat tool failures and ambiguous negatives as non-definitive will prevent the agent from uncritically accepting false negatives without introducing benchmark-specific leakage.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The previous prompt was syntactically corrupted and contained specific references that caused leakage or crashes; a clean, general prompt is required to restore functionality and guide behavior correctly.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) q000001 and q000005 failed because the agent accepted negative VQA outputs as definitive; the new prompt explicitly warns against this. (preservative) q000003 succeeded by direct visual reasoning; the new prompt preserves this by encouraging re-examination of original pixels. (transfer) The principle of treating tool negatives as probabilistic applies to any medical imaging task where subtle pathology may be missed.
edits.regression_risk: Low; the change removes specific biases and restores general best practices for medical image analysis.
edits.mechanism: Replacing the corrupted, task-specific prompt with a clean, general instruction to treat tool failures and ambiguous negatives as non-definitive will prevent the agent from uncritically accepting false negatives without introducing benchmark-specific leakage.
